names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 28 iunie, «Sfântul Mucenic Papias».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 28 Ιουνίου, «Άγιος Παππίας», with the rank word left off. The page spells the name with a double pi, which is how it tells him from the Παπίας of 31 Ιανουαρίου.

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «Născut în secolul al IV-lea, pe vremea împăratului Dioclețian, Sfântul Mucenic Papias a moștenit iubirea pentru Dumnezeu». The page gives no year of his death.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 28 iunie — «Sfântul Mucenic Papias»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Παππίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and it is the same martyrdom: a man seized only for believing in Christ, who would not deny the faith and was beheaded. saint.gr puts him among the victims under Diocletian and Maximian and dates that «(301 μ.Χ.)», where the folder's Romanian source has the fourth century and Diocletian; the two agree, and 301 is inside the reign. It adds the days of imprisonment and torture before the beheading. No `dates` object is proposed, because the year comes from this second source alone. He is not the corpus's Papias of Corinth, whose Greek row is already venerated on 31 Ιανουαρίου among the martyrs of Corinth; the page spells this one «Παππίας», with the double pi. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
